title: Hematic Iron
subtitle: First steps in blood-smithing
text: Hematic Iron is your entry-level material. Create a Hematic Iron Block via blood structure recipe, then break it into Hematic Iron Scraps. These scraps craft into a full armor set, a sword, and tools using the Knapper. Hematic Iron is roughly on par with iron but carries the taint of blood, making it compatible with further Hemomancy upgrades.
